title.zh: 补齐初级课程 1,000 词完整试学

purpose.en: Replace the old ten-word anonymous vocabulary demo with the published Beginner catalog, a SmartCard learning loop, status reports, and a daily progress score.
purpose.zh: 用正式发布的 Beginner 词库、完整智慧卡学习循环、状态报告和今日进度分替换旧的 10 词匿名演示。

en: Read all 1,000 published Beginner words through a new anonymous GET-only catalog endpoint without learner-data writes.
Practice ten daily SmartCards through flip-to-meaning, answer-with-hints, and five repeat-after-AI pronunciation rounds.
Show a large daily progress score plus Mastered, Learning, and Pending tabs with counts and paged word lists.
Require the same flip-before-answer study step in the signed-in 21-day vocabulary center.
zh: 通过新的匿名只读 GET 词库接口读取全部 1,000 个已发布 Beginner 词条，不写入学习者数据。
每日练习 10 张智慧卡，依次完成翻卡看释义、带提示答题和五轮跟 AI 跟读。
显示醒目的今日进度分，以及带数量和分页词表的学会了、正在学、还未学三栏报告。
登录后的 21 天词汇中心同样必须先翻卡学习再答题。

en: Anonymous Beginner trial routes for all twelve target languages
zh: 十二种目标语言的匿名初级试学路由
已发布 Beginner 词汇只读接口
登录课程的词汇记忆中心

en: Build deterministic ten-card daily decks and four-choice questions from the language's published Beginner catalog.
Keep anonymous statuses and scores in React page memory only and reset them on refresh.
Provide retry hints only in practice, microphone-denial guidance, and a no-speech-recognition completion fallback.
Render word lists in bounded batches of 100 to keep older iPads responsive.
zh: 从目标语言正式发布的 Beginner 词库确定性生成每日 10 卡和四选一题组。
匿名状态和分数仅保存在 React 页面内存中，刷新即重置。
仅练习模式提供逐次提示，并加入麦克风拒绝说明和无语音识别时的完成后备路径。
词表每次最多显示 100 个，保持旧款 iPad 的响应速度。

en: All 297 automated site tests, including the 48,000-row multilingual vocabulary and pronunciation corpus
Verified production build, artifact validation, sensitive-data scan, and source-drift checks
Chrome and Safari tests of the Chinese-interface Japanese Beginner trial, flip flow, report counts, responsive containment, and production catalog
zh: 全部 297 项自动化测试，包括 48,000 条多语言词汇和音标语料校验
已验证生产构建、产物、敏感信息扫描和源码漂移检查
使用 Chrome 与 Safari 验证中文界面学习日语初级试学、翻卡流程、报告数量、响应式容纳和生产词库

en: Live microphone scoring requires the user's browser permission and spoken input; the production UI and retry/fallback states were verified without retaining audio or transcripts.
zh: 实时发音评分需要用户允许浏览器麦克风并实际开口；生产环境已验证权限说明、重试和后备状态，且不保留音频或文字。

en: Keep SmartLingo vocabulary data, learner progress, identity, and deployment resources site-local; anonymous trial access is read-only.
zh: SmartLingo 词汇数据、学习进度、身份系统和部署资源均保持本站独立；匿名试学只读访问。
